acceptance_predicates.description: Development install, upgrade, remove and launch honor offline, dry-run and launch options.
All development lifecycle mutations use the router lifecycle lock.
Missing authentication, signatures and key management are explicit warning codes and never block development.
Install, status, doctor and launch expose exact source commit/tree and executable digests.
Exact protected-main merge and all required hosted checks are recorded in the receipt.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes local lifecycle tests and hosted checks.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and independent review evidence.

inputs.description: Current dev-channel ASB and asb-tui source heads.
Existing bounded clone/build, publication, rollback and launch router.

outputs.description: Atomic, lock-protected development TUI install and launch lifecycle with provenance and warnings.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on merged head.
